messages:
Nima (People Ops): Uploaded handbook amendment: 'External Events, Sponsorships & Gifts' 12 Focus is on pre-approval for sponsored travel, meal limits, and vendor gift acceptance. Need manager ack plan and a short anti-fraud microtraining.

Kelly (Finance): Reviewing limits now. We've tightened discretionary meal cap to $75/day and require card + receipt for any amount > $25. Also adding a vendor-gift register.

Arjun (Eng Manager): OK. For sponsored travel, can managers approve ad-hoc invites from vendors or must pass through Recruiting/People Ops? Had a last-minute conf invite last month.

Nima (People Ops): All sponsored travel must go through People Ops for pre-approval; emergency exceptions allowed but require retro signoff and a short justification. I added a one-click preapproval form link in the doc.

Lydia (Legal): Added a short conflicts-of-interest checklist and a clause about third-party-funded training that changes IP/NDAs. Recommend adding a box on the form to flag funded content.

Nima (People Ops): Good call. Rollout plan: manager-level ack only. Two waves: Wave 1 = managers who approve travel or external spend; Wave 2 = all managers. Target completion: 9 business days. Reminder cadence: day 0, day 3, day 6. If Wave 1 < 70% at day 5 escalate to finance leads.

Kelly (Finance): I'll provide the CSV of approvers and team sizes. Can we auto-log acks into the finance tracker so approvals are auditable?

Nima (People Ops): Yes 12 include manager_id in the ack link; Hiring Ops/Finance webhook will append to the tracker. Also require managers to watch a 12-min microtraining on fraud indicators and complete a 5-question quiz.

Arjun (Eng Manager): Can the ack page show recent examples of acceptable docs so managers don't over-escalate?

Nima (People Ops): Adding a short examples appendix and a one-paragraph script managers can use when declining vendor-funded travel.

notify-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Handbook: External Events & Gifts 0 - Manager ack due in 9d" 0 sending Wave 1 in 10 minutes.

Lydia (Legal): I'll review the funded-content checkbox language by EOD and flag any IP risks.

Kelly (Finance): CSV export ready; will drop in People Ops drive and ping when done.

Nima (People Ops): Final action items: Lydia finalize legal wording, Kelly upload approver list, I'll publish the microtraining videos (two EMEA/APAC times) and send the first wave tomorrow. Will announce to company after Wave 1 hits 75% ack.

Arjun (Eng Manager): Acknowledged ":thumbsup:" will DM two edge cases I know of."
